headline: SURFACE DISCOVERY: Collective Mining Outlines 700m Gold-Silver Oxide Zone at Apollo — 71m at 1.95 g/t AuEq From Grass
snippet: Collective Mining (TSX: CNL) has outlined a 700-metre-by-200-metre corridor of oxidized gold-silver mineralization sitting directly on surface at Northern Apollo in Colombia, with drill intercepts including 71.20m at 1.95 g/t AuEq from grass. The oxide zone sits north of the company's large Apollo breccia deposit and could support a future open-pit option on top of the primary underground resource — $113M in the treasury funds 100,000m of 2026 drilling.

headline: BEST HOLE EVER: GR Silver Drills 45m at 1,623 g/t Ag at San Marcial — 8.25m Core at 8,579 g/t Sets Project Record
snippet: GR Silver Mining (TSXV: GRSL) posted the highest-grade drill hole in San Marcial project history — 45.1 metres at 1,623 g/t silver in hole SMS26-04, including a bonanza 8.25-metre interval at 8,579 g/t Ag — in the SE Area expansion zone several hundred metres down-dip from surface. The result confirms the geological model ahead of an updated Mineral Resource Estimate targeted for H2 2026, with two rigs on site and additional equipment in transit.

headline: Troilus Hits 2.92 g/t AuEq Over 19m at West Rim — High-Grade 200m From Reserve Pit, M&A Analysts Take Notice
snippet: Troilus Mining (TSX: TLG) expanded the West Rim Zone at its Quebec copper-gold project with a 2.92 g/t gold-equivalent intercept over 19 metres — outside the current resource boundary and just 200 metres from the North Reserve Pit outlined in the 2024 Feasibility Study. The result includes a 7.82 g/t AuEq core over 5 metres, extending a zone that now traces over one kilometre of high-grade strike with limited drilling to the south and at depth.

headline: NexGold Confirms High-Grade Continuity at Goldlund — Campaign 75% Done, Resource Expansion Signalled
snippet: NexGold Mining (TSXV: NEXG) reported additional high-grade infill results from Zone 4 of the Goldlund deposit at its Goliath Gold Complex in northwestern Ontario, with the 25,000-metre 2026 campaign now approximately 75% complete. Results continue to support geological continuity and potential expansion of the Mineral Resource at depth approaching the base of the current open-pit Resource.

headline: GOLD BELOW $4,500: Iran Talks Stall, Silver Breaks $74 Support — Metals Down 20% From January All-Time Highs
snippet: Gold slipped below $4,500 and silver broke the $74 support level on May 19 as stalled Iran nuclear talks added to already-hawkish signals from April CPI data, lifting the dollar and weighing on precious metals. Gold is now roughly 20% off its $5,589 January all-time high while silver — which hit a record $121.64 in January — has given back the bulk of those gains with a 5.6% single-session drop.

headline: LITHIUM AT 2-YEAR HIGH: China Carbonate Tops $195K/Tonne as Energy Storage Demand Blows Past Supply Forecasts
snippet: Lithium carbonate prices in China surged to a two-year peak above CNY 200,500 per tonne in mid-May before easing slightly on restarts by marginal producers, driven by a combination of supply constraints and surging demand from grid-scale energy storage. Morgan Stanley forecasts an 80,000-tonne LCE deficit for 2026 as AI data-centre battery systems and accelerating EV adoption add to demand that was already growing at 71% annually from storage applications in 2025.

headline: GoldSeek SWOT: K92 Mining Holds Above Key Support as PNG Gold Producer Reiterates 2026 Production Guidance
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Gold SWOT analysis highlights K92 Mining (TSX: KNT) as a relative standout — the Papua New Guinea gold producer reiterated its 2026 production guidance and is maintaining technical support above its 50-day moving average despite broad precious metals sector selling. For investors evaluating gold producers through the current $4,500 pullback, the piece flags KNT as a name holding fundamentals while the sector reprices.

headline: Silver and Platinum Diverge From Gold's Retreat — Industrial Demand Signals Split From Safe-Haven Premium
snippet: In InvestingNews's latest precious metals weekly update, silver and platinum are moving on different logic from gold — with silver falling harder than gold on the safe-haven selloff but platinum showing relative strength on auto-catalyst demand. The divergence matters for mining-stock selectors: silver miners are being hit more than gold producers in the pullback, while PGM-focused names may offer a more defensive position.

headline: Analysts: Troilus West Rim Results Put Quebec Gold Asset on Mid-Tier M&A Radar — Feasibility Already in Hand
snippet: Mining.com analyst coverage of Troilus Mining's West Rim expansion results notes that the combination of high-grade intercepts near the reserve pit, a completed Feasibility Study, and 40,000m of 2026 drilling makes Troilus one of the more de-risked development assets in Quebec for a mid-tier gold producer looking to grow in a safe mining jurisdiction. The West Rim Zone's open strike extent adds additional resource optionality beyond the existing plan.

headline: GoldSeek Issue #72: Mining Stocks Awaiting a Catalyst — Gold, Silver Sector Consolidates as Technicals Hold Key Levels
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly mining roundup (Issue #72) surveys the gold, silver and mining stock landscape with precious metals in consolidation mode after January's historic highs, arguing that the sector is coiling for its next leg and that the current pullback is healthy technical action rather than a trend reversal. The piece reviews junior and senior producer technicals and identifies the conditions that would reignite the next catalyst-driven move.
